# R-0001 regression inputs

`approved-design.json` and `approved-plan.json` retain the exact input bytes from
the completed R-0001 delivery at commit
`98714892ab61ec99a6c2d1f3a7dc18a60b52750b`. Traceability and wiring tests consume
these historical inputs; they are not an active plan, an approval for new work,
or evidence that the current checkout has passed any journey.

The other fixtures in this directory retain their existing test roles.
